source_snapshot.procedure: Get latest/12.3.1 ARM64-SBSA installer; install; check with nvidia-smi.

old_problem: Latest versus 12.3.1 is unbound; nvidia-smi does not prove toolkit version or feature parity and no feature matrix exists.
disposition_reason: CUDA 12 family and feature-parity purpose are identifiable. Exact CUDA12 release, package and project feature matrix are runtime prerequisites; separate nvcc/toolkit evidence fixes the driver-only check.
decision_basis: Preserved installation and feature-parity scope while separating toolkit from driver evidence.

test_case.purpose: Install the approved CUDA12 SBSA toolkit and execute every signed parity feature against the supported GPU/driver stack.
test_case.test_command: Verify package; install approved toolkit components without changing driver unless authorized; record nvcc/toolkit metadata separately from nvidia-smi; run every parity test and health check.
test_case.expected_result: Exact toolkit version is installed, all required features pass their signed oracle, and the supported driver/GPU stack remains healthy.
test_case.pass_fail_basis: nvidia-smi driver version, installer exit or an unpinned latest package cannot prove toolkit feature parity.
test_case.recovery: Remove/rollback toolkit components per package policy and restore environment/library paths.
